description: First-frame stills of the existing homepage wave for immediate display while its live renderer initializes.
source: js/paper-wave.mjs, worker frame 12000, using the homepage uniforms and pixel budgets
processing: Capture the raw wave without page content, masks, saturation or CSS blur. Resize desktop to 1000px, retain mobile at 390px, blur 3px and encode as WebP quality 70. CSS applies the page effects.
